predecessors.text: the Hejaz, where Ibn al-Zubayr was proclaimed

successors.name: Umayyad Caliphate
successors.text: the Hejaz without Ta'if, the last Zubayrid land

ledger.x: Page silent on the date.
Page silent on when.
Page silent on the date.
Nov 683: Ibn al-Zubayr proclaims himself caliph at Mecca.

Nov 683 on: Second Fitna page: Ibn al-Zubayr 'was openly proclaimed caliph' after Yazid's death in November 683; 'Iraq and Egypt recognized him soon after, and most provinces recognized Ibn al-Zubayr as caliph'.

Page silent on a date and on the list: the Mukhtar page has Iraq, once Mukhtar took Kufa from the Zubayrid governor, with 'its dependencies including Arminiya, Adharbayjan, Jibal and parts of the Jazira'; the Second Fitna page 'most provinces recognized Ibn al-Zubayr'.

684: Salm appointed Ibn Khazim in the summer of 684; he 'gave his allegiance to the Mecca-based caliph Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr' and was the 'nominal Zubayrid governor of the same province between 684 and his death', without a year for the recognition and without…
Aug 684: Marj Rahit.
Aug 684: after Marj Rahit 'The surviving Qaysis fled to the Jazira under Zufar ibn al-Harith al-Kilabi, who continued to recognize Ibn al-Zubayr's suzerainty'.
Second Fitna page: the Azariqa 'captured Fars and Kirman from the Zubayrids in 685'.
Mar 685: Egypt lost.
Oct 685: Second Fitna page: Mukhtar 'overthrew the Zubayrid governor and seized Kufa' in October 685 and held 'most of Iraq and parts of north-western Iran'.
Page silent on when: after taking Kufa Mukhtar 'controlled most of Iraq and its dependencies including Arminiya, Adharbayjan, Jibal and parts of the Jazira'.
3 Apr 687: Mukhtar page: Mus'ab 'besieged Mukhtar's palace for four months' and 'on 3 April 687 Mukhtar came out of the palace with nineteen supporters' and was killed.
Second Fitna page: Najda 'captured Yemen and Hadhramawt in 688'.
Second Fitna page: Najda 'occupied Ta'if in 689'; the Abd Allah page agrees ('Ta'if in 689').

Oct 691: Second Fitna page: Mus'ab 'was killed at the Battle of Maskin in October 691' and 'Abd al-Malik reconquered Iraq after the Battle of Maskin'; the Abd Allah page: 'his forces conquered Iraq and killed Mus'ab'.
691: 'In 691, he besieged the Qaysite stronghold of Qarqisiya in the Jazira'; the page does not say when it fell, so 691 is my bridging for the Jazira's return, with Iraq.
692: 'At some time before the end of 692, Ibn Khazim was intercepted and killed by Bukayr ibn Wisha al-Sa'di's troops'; Bukayr, who sent his head to Abd al-Malik, succeeded him.
Mar 692: Second Fitna page: the siege of Mecca by al-Hajjaj began in March 692; the Abd Allah page: 'Al-Hajjaj besieged Mecca for six months'.
Oct 692: Mecca falls.
Oct 692: 'the Hejaz came under Umayyad control' after Ibn al-Zubayr's death.
Oct 692: death of Ibn al-Zubayr.

wars.name: Second Fitna
wars.outcome: Umayyad victory: Ibn al-Zubayr killed in October/November 692, the Zubayrid Caliphate dissolved.

certainty.note: Authority outside the Hejaz was 'largely nominal' (Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr page); the allegiance of provinces is recorded, not their borders.
